category: Planninq competes as team project and task management inside Nextcloud: projects with members, a kanban board per project with work in progress limits, a backlog, a task page with comments, attachments and dependencies, a per-project Gantt timeline, due reminders, personal time logging with a timesheet, and a capacity and portfolio view across projects, for internal IT, development and project teams in Dutch public organisations. It is project planning and work management. It is not rostering or shift planning (humaniq owns that) and not booking of rooms or equipment. A buyer who already runs Nextcloud compares it first with Nextcloud Deck, which is on the same platform for free, then with the open source project management suites OpenProject, Plane and Kanboard, and with the market leader Jira, which the product's own description names as the complexity it avoids.
